summary: Calagopus is a self-hosted control panel designed for managing multiplayer game servers such as Minecraft and Hytale. It provides administrative utilities to deploy, monitor, and oversee various game instances from a centralized interface. The system is built using Rust and utilizes Docker containers for deployment.
goodFor: Administrators and communities who want a modern, open-source dashboard to manage multiple game server instances on their own hardware.
watchOut: As a relatively niche project with a modest repository star count, you may encounter edge cases, limited community documentation, or fewer third-party integrations compared to more established game panels.
deployNotes: Because it relies on Docker and packages via deb, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for game data and set up a reverse proxy with TLS termination for secure access.
